$comment: Keys are suite/case/tool. Entries may be scoped with platforms (array) and path (combined|per-case). A listed failure that starts passing is STALE and fails CI — remove it when the upstream limitation clears. An entry never turns a benchmark validity failure into a ranked PASS.
$comment-discipline: Expected still failing = accepted+reported; expected passing = stale = exit 1; unexpected failure = exit 1. Package upgrades re-run every plant automatically (versions are exactly pinned in package.json).
